## v1.34.0

Closes the gaps found by live checks of the v1.33.0 authoring contract, and adds screen share: an agent setting and a one-call browser API. Two read shapes change, see "Behavior change".

### Added

- `session.startScreenShare()` and `stopScreenShare()` on `KalturaAvatarSession`. The browser picks the screen, the SDK sends a JPEG still every 2 seconds, and the share ends on `disconnect()` or when the user stops it. New `screenSharing` getter, `screenShareChanged` event, and `screen_share_denied`, `screen_share_unsupported` and `screen_share_failed` errors (#PR)
- `examples/screen-share-agent.html`: a debugging assistant that looks at the user's screen. Run it with `AGENTIC_SCREEN_SHARE=1 node examples/dev-server.mjs` (#PR)
- `screenShare: { enabled, prompt }` on `agents.create`, `agents.update`, `agents.get` and `agents.list`. Turn it on to let an avatar session share its screen. `sys__avatar_share_screen_enabled` is true while a share runs (#358)
- `tool_ids` and `thread_start_tools` setters accept `{ id, condition }` entries, so one attachment can carry its own condition (#358)
- `lintPrompts`, `intellectConfig.audit()` and `mgmt.doctor()` warn on condition forms that blank the turn: `AND`, `&&`, `!`, a single `=`, `len()`, `true` (#358)
- `audit` reports an `api` tool arg that is declared but never sent (#358)
- `npm run live-verify:avatar-flag`: live check that `sys__avatar_enabled` is true in a browser avatar session and false in a plain conversation, for a prompt block, a compound condition, a skill and a `var` tool. With `--share` it also starts a real screen share and checks `sys__avatar_share_screen_enabled` (#358, #PR)

### Changed

- `tools.api` rejects an undeclared `{name}` at any depth of an object body (#358)
- `intellects.add`, `create`, `update`, `setPrompts` and `intellectConfig.patch` reject a template-style prompt-block `condition` before the write (#358)
- `tools.update` accepts the `null` fields the server echoes (#358)

### Fixed

- `audit` and `doctor` no longer report `skill_not_found` for an attached shared skill (#358)
- `audit` no longer reports a false `tool_not_found` for a tool attached with a condition (#358)
- `lintPrompts` no longer flags `{{name}}` when `name` is set by a `var` tool (#358)

### Behavior change

- `tool_ids` and `thread_start_tools` read back as `[{ id, condition }]` where an attachment has a condition. Code that treats every entry as a string id must read `entry.id` too (#358)
- `tools.delete` now sees those references and refuses with `tool_in_use` while a tool is attached (#358)

### Docs and skill

- Screen share guide in "Create an Avatar and an Agent", and the screen-share events in the wire events catalog (#PR)
- `appInit` flag fields such as `legacyScreenShareEnabled` are the server's names and may change. Docs and code hints now say to use the agent's `screenShare` through the SDK instead (#PR)
- One home each for the condition grammar, prompt block fields, `previewPrompt` keys, audit codes, `{arg}` placeholder rules and shared-skill rules (#358)
- Live checks now cover shared skills, the duplicate-name 409, nested `{arg}` fill and condition findings on a real account (#358)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.33.0...v1.34.0
